The affix खच् comes after the verb यस् 'to curb'when the word वाक् 'speech' is in composition with it as an object and the sense indicated is that of a vow.

Terms: खच्

The affix ग्मिनि come in the sense of मतुप् after the word वाच्।

Terms: ग्मिनि

The affix ठक् comes after वाच् when it means the purport of the message spoken by another.

Terms: ठक्

The semi-vowels of the roots वच् , स्वप् , and यजादि verbs are vocalised when followed by an affix having an indicatory क।

Terms: लकार-बहुव्रीही

वाचंयम and पुरंदर are irregularly formed.

Terms: Irregular

A guttural is not substituted for the final of वच् before ण्यत् when it does not mean 'a word or speech'.

Terms: Guttarlisation

The augment उ is added after the अ of वच् in the Aorist अङ्।

Terms: Shortening
